title: enhanced-autorollback-workflow-for-canary-ab-shadow
author: Avery Chen
description: Motivation: Reduce manual intervention and flakiness during multi-mode rollouts (canary, A/B, shadow) by improving the autorollback engine, telemetry, and safety guards. This change tightens metric quorums, adds a quarantine probing stage, and surfaces per-route rollback decisions in the Console. Goals: 1) Reduce false-positive rollbacks for transient noise, 2) Make automated rollback decisions auditable in Console and logs, 3) Provide an operator override path and manual quarantine for suspect variants. Changes include: - Autorollback engine: introduce composite-metric thresholds, metric quorum (min successful probes), and exponential backoff before final rollback. - Probing/quarantine stage: when an unstable variant is detected, move traffic to a short-lived probing stage that runs targeted probes (latency, error-rate, regression tests) before full rollback. - Observability: new telemetry metrics (rollout_decision_reason, quarantine_duration, probe_pass_rate) and Console UI hooks to view decision traces. - Safety: per-rollout and global stability guards, configurable grace windows, and an operator-initiated manual quarantine API. - Tests: add unit tests for quorum logic, e2e stability tests that simulate intermittent failures, and canary/AB/shadow integration tests. Backwards compatibility: default behavior is unchanged; new features are opt-in via rollout policy flags. See linked Linear tasks for rollout criteria and SLO numbers. Checklist: - [x] design doc (ENG-2034) - [x] implementation - [x] unit tests - [x] e2e integration tests - [x] Console integration hooks - [x] rollout policy feature gating - [x] docs and release notes See commits for implementation breakdown and files_changed for touched areas.

review_comments: Samir Gupta (review): The quorum logic looks good, but we should be conservative with default quorum sizes for low-traffic routes. Please add a fallback to tolerate when sample size < min_quorum.
Avery Chen (author): Added fallback path and unit tests for small-sample scenarios (see evaluator_test.go).
Maya Lopez (review): Observability hooks are helpful — please add a small chart in Console showing probe_pass_rate over the last 10 minutes.
Avery Chen (author): Console trace view updated with probe_pass_rate sparkline and link to probe logs.
Evan Brooks (review): e2e test flaked in the first run (timing). Increased probe timeouts and added retry with exponential backoff. Re-ran e2e suite; all green.
